mission.title: coredns: Add first-class structured / JSON logging support
mission.description: Add first-class structured / JSON logging support. Requested by 9+ users.

steps.title: Check current coredns deployment
steps.description:
Verify your coredns version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n coredns -l app.kubernetes.io/name=coredns
helm list -n coredns 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working coredns installation.

steps.title: Review coredns configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant coredns configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n coredns -l app.kubernetes.io/name=coredns
kubectl get configmap -n coredns -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=coredns
```
Hi CoreDNS community!

I’d like to re-open the discussion around structured (JSON) logging support in CoreDNS.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Add first-class structured / JSON logging support
steps.description:
Add opt-in JSON logging with `-log-format=json`, while keeping text output as the default.
The format is selected once for the process, so server blocks and Corefile reloads cannot
change it independently.

The existing `plugin/pkg/log` helpers use a shared standard-library `slog.JSONHandler`
in
```yaml
{"ts":"...","level":"info","plugin":"log","msg":"...", "fields":{...}}
```

steps.title: Upgrade coredns to include the fix
steps.description:
If the fix is included in a newer release, upgrade coredns:
```bash
helm repo update
helm upgrade coredns coredns/coredns --namespace coredns
```
Verify the upgrade:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n coredns
helm list -n coredns
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n coredns -l app.kubernetes.io/name=coredns
kubectl get events -n coredns --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Add first-class structured / JSON logging support" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
Add opt-in JSON logging with `-log-format=json`, while keeping text output as the default.
The format is selected once for the process, so server blocks and Corefile reloads cannot
change it independently.

The existing `plugin/pkg/log` helpers use a shared standard-library `slog.JSONHandler`
in JSON mode.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with coredns installed or the issue environment reproducible.
